Luxury Steals are a small number of pieces offered at a price we cannot repeat. When one sells, it is gone — we are not holding more in the back.

Everything in Luxury Steals is final sale. No returns, no exchanges, no cash refunds, no merchandise credit. Please buy from this section only if you are certain, and ask us anything you want to know first; we would much rather answer questions than have you stuck with something.

Final sale does not take away your warranty. If a Luxury Steal turns out to have a manufacturing fault, the one-year limited warranty applies to it exactly as it does to anything else we sell.

You will be asked to confirm you understand this before you can buy. The wording is below.
